title: Extension by the empty set of a sheaf of sets along an open subset
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space, $U\subseteq X$ an open subset with inclusion $j_U:U\to X$, and $\mathcal G$ a sheaf of sets on $U$. The presheaf of sets $j_{U,p!}\mathcal G$ on $X$ is defined by $(j_{U,p!}\mathcal G)(V)=\mathcal G(V)$ if $V\subseteq U$ and $(j_{U,p!}\mathcal G)(V)=\emptyset$ if $V\not\subseteq U$ ($V\subseteq X$ open); for opens $V'\subseteq V$ the restriction map is the restriction map of $\mathcal G$ when $V\subseteq U$ (then $V'\subseteq U$), and the empty map when $V\not\subseteq U$. The *extension of $\mathcal G$ by the empty set* is the sheaf of sets $j_{U!}\mathcal G$ on $X$ given by the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] $j_{U,p!}\mathcal G\to j_{U!}\mathcal G$. A morphism $\alpha:\mathcal G\to\mathcal G'$ of sheaves on $U$ gives $j_{U,p!}\alpha$ (equal to $\alpha_V$ on $V\subseteq U$, empty otherwise) and hence $j_{U!}\alpha$. For a set $S$ write $\underline S_U$ for the sheaf of sets on $U$ with $\underline S_U(V)=\{$locally constant maps $V\to S\}$ ($V\subseteq U$ open, restriction of maps), and $j_{U!}\underline S:=j_{U!}(\underline S_U)$.
